# 1bit.MONSTER

> One engine, any model. A model-agnostic, hardware-agnostic pure-C++ inference engine (GPL-3.0): 568 architecture tokens, 2,040 HF arch strings, 99.97% HuggingFace coverage, 323,579 checkpoints mapped, running on Ryzen AI NPUs and ROCm with a GGUF-native 1-bit pipeline. Zero Python at runtime.
